# Resize Image

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Resizes an image to a certain height and width.

## Syntax

~~~~text
resizeImage(image: <#Variable#>, height: <#Number (Allows Variables)#>, width: <#Number (Allows Variables)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
resizeImage(image: Clipboard, height: 1024, width: 1024)
~~~~
